caption: The drawing features a square piece of light-colored fabric, possibly white or cream, set against an off-white background. Within the square fabric, there is a symmetrical design created with a series of small, closely spaced dots forming the outline of a stylized basket or pot at the bottom center. From the basket, several curved stems rise and branch out, each ending in cluster-like forms that resemble stylized flowers or leaves. The stems and floral elements are evenly distributed, creating a balanced composition. Curved lines with similar dot patterns form a border around the edges of the square, incorporating additional abstract floral or leaf motifs that mirror the central design. The image uses a very limited, almost monochromatic color palette, primarily shades of white and very light gray. The drawing appears to be a depiction of an embroidered or perforated textile pattern. At the bottom right corner of the background, faint printed text reads "Mary C. Davidson."
title: Handwoven Linen
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
